employeesYE.label: Employees by reporting region
employeesYE.definition: 'Employees by reporting region' in the Annual Report's Global reach and presence graphic, using AstraZeneca's financial reporting regions (US, Europe, Established Rest of World, Emerging Markets); total 96,100 employees. The report notes that the categorisation of employees was updated to align with its financial reporting regions.

employeesAvg.label: Average employees by location of employing entity
employeesAvg.definition: Monthly average number of people employed, to the nearest hundred, including part-time employees, by location of the legal entity employing staff (Note 29); continuing operations total 95,100. Certain staff work in a different location.

notes: Two employee bases are published and both are kept, as separate metrics: year-end 2025 headcount by financial reporting region (US 17,900; Europe 34,000; Emerging Markets 36,800; Established RoW 7,400; total 96,100), and the 2025 monthly average by location of the employing legal entity (UK 10,600; Rest of Europe 26,900; The Americas 25,200; Asia, Africa & Australasia 32,400; total 95,100). They overlap (Europe includes the UK; The Americas includes the US) and must not be added. The 2025 report says the categorisation of employees by reporting region was updated to align with its financial reporting regions, which partly explains the shift from Europe (37,100 at end-2024) to Emerging Markets (31,800 at end-2024); the two years are not strictly comparable. The 2025 report states 16,900 employees across its manufacturing sites, 31 operations sites in 15 countries (three under construction), 10 global hubs and six strategic R&D centres (Beijing opened in 2025). Sites: HQ, four R&D centres and the Barcelona hub are sourced to the 2025 report. The 2025 report no longer names the other hubs or repeats the Södertälje emissions line, so Södertälje and the Guadalajara, San José, Mississauga, Lisbon and Dublin hubs keep their 2024 Annual Report source (still online); Beijing is not added, to stay within 12 sites. Taxes by country are not published: AstraZeneca's 'Our approach to taxation' (astrazeneca.com) says the territory-by-territory report is submitted to UK tax authorities, so the country-by-country report is private. No U.S. state breakdown is published.
